next.reason: 1985: '[ALL] LOW-VALUE(S) Except in the SPECIAL-NAMES paragraph, represents one or more of the character that has the lowest ordinal position in the program collating sequence'. 2023: 'The character that has the lowest ordinal position in the program collating sequence is associated with the figurative constant LOW-VALUE, except when this figurative constant is specified as a literal in the SPECIAL-NAMES paragraph' (§2023:12.3.7.4 GR9), spellings in §2023:8.3.3.6.2, and §2023:8.3.3.6.4 GR7 ('the low-value format represents the character, or multiple-character combination, that has the lowest ordinal position'). The locale, national and runtime-sequence cases arise only from facilities this rule neither allows nor refuses; same value for every program it governs.
